gloss: the previous week; the week before

definitions.gloss: the previous week; the week before
definitions.explanation: The week before a given week. A formal word used in reports, statistics and the news, especially for week-on-week comparisons; in everyday talk about the current week, people say {先週|せんしゅう}.

examples.japanese: {前週|ぜんしゅう}⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It rose compared with the previous week.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前週|ぜんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}った→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧。
examples.english: Sales were higher than the week before.

examples.japanese: {新規感染者数|しんきかんせんしゃすう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{前週|ぜんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{曜日|ようび}→曜日：03877_youbi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{二割|にわり}⟦{少|すく}なかった→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: The number of new infections was about twenty percent lower than on the same day the previous week.

notes:
{前週|ぜんしゅう} counts back from whatever week is under discussion, while ⟦{先週|せんしゅう}→先週：00752_senshuu⟧ always means the week before this one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前週比|ぜんしゅうひ}: week-on-week, compared with the previous week
- {前週|ぜんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧ / ⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧: to be above / below the previous week
- {前週末|ぜんしゅうまつ}: the previous weekend

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先週|せんしゅう}→先週：00752_senshuu⟧: last week — the everyday word
- ⟦{翌週|よくしゅう}→翌週：25325_yokushuu⟧: the following week — the formal opposite
- ⟦{前月|ぜんげつ}→前月：21207_zengetsu⟧: the previous month
